About the Opportunities:

We are actively seeking Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Consultants to join our network of professionals. With roles available across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), we offer a platform for ESG experts who are passionate about making a tangible impact on environmental, social, and governance issues. Our roles cater to a diverse range of expertise and experience levels, from entry-level positions to senior consulting roles.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct comprehensive ESG assessments and develop strategies to address identified risks and opportunities.
  • Work closely with clients to integrate sustainable, responsible practices into their business operations.
  • Provide guidance on ESG reporting and compliance with relevant regulations and standards.
  • Lead and contribute to research and analysis in specific ESG domains, producing actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Foster relationships with stakeholders to promote ESG initiatives and drive positive change.
  • Participate in workshops, seminars, and other events to stay updated on ESG trends and best practices.

Requirements:

  • A proven track record in ESG consulting, with expertise in environmental, social, and governance issues. Experience levels can range from entry-level to senior positions.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate data and trends to make informed recommendations.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of effectively articulating complex ESG concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • A collaborative mindset, able to work effectively in team environments and manage relationships with clients and stakeholders.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying abreast of the latest developments in ESG standards and practices.
  • Relevant academic background in environmental science, social sciences, business, or related fields is preferred.

Why Apply?

This is a unique opportunity to contribute your skills to meaningful projects that have a real-world impact on sustainability and corporate governance. By joining our network, you'll engage with diverse clients across the MENA region, gain exposure to a wide range of industries, and play a key role in shaping responsible business practices for the future.

Job Description:

Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Coordinator (VSG UK)

The Vesta Software Group acquires, manages, and builds software companies in a variety of vertical markets, enabling them to be clear leaders in their industries. Our companies provide mission-critical enterprise solutions for vertical industries across the entire industry value chain globally.

Being a portfolio group of Jonas Software (within Constellation Software Inc.), the Vesta Software Group is all about strengthening businesses within the markets in which we compete and enabling them to grow – whether through organic measures such as new initiatives and product development, day-to-day business, or through acquisitions.

Job Purpose

The ESG Coordinator will support the development, implementation and ongoing delivery of the Company's Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy. Working closely with Business Unit Leaders, Portfolio Managers, ESG Champions and Senior Leadership Teams globally, the role will coordinate ESG activities, monitor progress against agreed objectives, support ESG reporting and help drive the achievement of the Company's global ESG goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and support the rollout of the Company's ESG strategy across all business units.
  • Work collaboratively with Business Unit Leaders, Portfolio Managers and the Senior Leadership Team to ensure ESG objectives are embedded within business plans and operational activities, including the completion of the ESG Scorecard on a quarterly basis.
  • Coordinate ESG projects and initiatives, ensuring agreed milestones, deadlines and deliverables are achieved.
  • Monitor progress against ESG targets and support the collection and analysis of ESG-related data and metrics.
  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies and delays in ESG submissions, working with stakeholders to resolve issues and escalating material risks where appropriate.
  • Maintain ESG project plans, documentation, action logs and reporting dashboards.
  • Support the preparation of ESG reports, updates and presentations for internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate and support ESG Champions across the business with carbon calculation data collection and the use of the Sweep platform.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and support the implementation of new ESG initiatives aligned to the Company's global goals.
  • Provide support and training on ESG to new business unit leaders and ESG champions as required.
  • Support the collation of information required for ESG reporting and compliance activities, working with internal subject matter experts and external advisers where appropriate.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Essential

  • Experience coordinating projects and managing multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • Strong organisational and planning skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Ability to analyse information and present findings clearly and accurately.
  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data and reporting.
  • Ability to identify trends, anomalies and gaps within data submissions.
  • Ability to manage sensitive and confidential business information appropriately.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across different levels of the organisation.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

Desirable

  • Previous experience working in ESG, sustainability, corporate responsibility or a related field.

  • Experience working with sustainability reporting systems or ESG data collection platforms.
  • Experience coordinating activities across multiple business units or regions.
  • Knowledge of ESG frameworks, reporting standards and emerging sustainability trends.
  • Experience producing reports and tracking performance metrics.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Collaboration and Teamwork
  • Planning and Organisation
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Accountability
  • Communication
  • Attention to Detail
  • Proactive Follow-through

Key Relationships

Internal

  • Chief People Officer
  • ESG Steering Committee
  • Senior Leadership Team
  • Business Unit Leaders
  • Portfolio Managers
  • ESG Champions
  • Functional teams across the Group

External

  • Industry bodies and sustainability partners
  • ESG consultants and advisers (where applicable)

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Brænder du for CSRD/ESG-rådgivning og rapportering?

Vil du vise vejen i CSRD- og ESG-rapportering sammen med BORG IT og E-SG.cloud? Kan du være med til at sikre, at vi yder den bedste service og sparring med vores kunder? Vores virksomheder er ambitiøse, valide og troværdige. Complient bæredygtighed er vigtigt for os og vores interessenter. Det så vigtigt, at vi udvikler vores egne systemer og IT værktøjer og etablerer særskilt virksomhed hertil. Vi tager endda skridtet videre og tilbyder vores værktøjer og erfaringer andre danske SMV'er.

BORG IT åbner endnu stillingmed fuldt fokus på CSRD-/ESG-rapportering. Vi arbejder på at komme i front med vores ESG- og miljø-rapportering, og har derfor grundlagt et søsterselskab med fokus på netop CSRD-/ESG- og miljørapportering. Du vil være en aktiv del af opstarten af vores nye forretning og en del af et dedikeret team, hvor hver yder sit og vi sammen skal være gode.

Ideelt set har du allerede en uddannelse og praktisk erfaring med ESG-rapportering, er bekendt med dataindsamling, -analyser og diverse miljøstandarder. Du er interesseret i at fortsætte i dette fagområde og forberedt på vedvarende forandringer omkring bæredygtighed/ESG-rapportering. Du er frist på at lære mere om Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS), GRI, SASB, IFRS etc. Opgaverne spænder bredt. Derfor leder vi efter en kollega med lyst og evne til at suge viden til sig, få tingene sat i værk og stille sig op på ølkassen og brede budskabet. Vi søger en kollega, der har lyst til at arbejde med data, finansielle løsninger, systemer og rapportering, men også med kundekontakt – alt sammen indenfor ESG-rapportering. Du er med til at sikre, at BORG IT og E-SG.cloud arbehjder med ESG Data og rapportering i særklasse, og du er med til at definere metoder, processer og rapporteringsløsninger.

En vigtig del af dit arbejde er at planlægge, udføre og kommunikere med beslutningstagere hos vores kunder. Du vil få ansvar for at præsentere vores virksomheder som ærlige, loyale, effektive og professionelle.

Derfor er det vigtigt, at du:

  • har en uddannelsesmæssig baggrund inden for enten regnskab, bæredygtighed, erhvervsøkonomi, ESG eller lignende på kandidatniveau.
  • kender (og helst med praktisk erfaring) til forskellige ESG-rapporteringsrammer, f.eks. CSRD, SFDR, TCFD, SBTi, NFRD, GHG-protokol etc.
  • er velbevandret i ESG og har en naturlig interesse i bæredygtighed.
  • har projekt erfaring indenfor bæredygtighed og er stærk i kvalitativ bæredygtighed
  • er videbegærlig og har lyst til forsat faglig udvikling
  • har sans for detaljen
  • har solide kommunikationsevner på dansk og engelsk - i skrift og tale
  • kan arbejde både alene og i teams, og sætter en ære i at udvikle kolleger og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • har det godt med at balancere fleksibilitet og korte deadlines – altid med kunden i fokus
  • har mod på rejseaktivitet

Vi tilbyder:

  • mulighed for at lære og udvikle dig hver dag.
  • yderst professionelle og kompetente kolleger.
  • udfordrende og unikke opgaver med en kreativ tilgang til problemløsning
  • en fælles rejse, hvor vi sammen bliver klogere og spiller hinanden gode
  • en fantastisk mulighed for at være med til at sætte den fremtidige retning for BORG IT og E-SG.cloud's ESG-rapportering og rådgivningstjenester.
  • mulighed for at arbejde hjemmefra. Rejseaktiviteter skal forventes.
  • opgaver, hvor du skal fordybe dig, men også opgaver, som vil være udadvendte og i dialog med kunder.
  • stor frihed og fleksibilitet i forhold til at tilrettelægge og planlægge din arbejdsdag.

Som udgangspunkt tilbydes stillingen som fuldtidsstilling (20 timer om ugen). Stillingen er baseret i Danmark.

Vi modtager ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende og lukker stillingen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Hos BORG IT er vi forpligtet til at udvikle forskellige talenter på alle niveauer. Vi opfordrer alle interesserede kandidater til at søge, uanset alder, race, seksuel orientering, handicap, religion eller etnicitet.

At Measurabl, the Sustainability Reporting Specialist is a member of the Sustainability Services Team who collaborates closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams. The right candidate will be detail-oriented, organized, and motivated to work for a mission-driven organization. The Sustainability Reporting Specialist also serves as the internal subject matter expert on city, state, and agency compliance ordinance requirements and deadlines.
  • This role is a 7 month seasonal/temporary role
  • The role will be for the period of December 2026 thru June 2027
  • These roles will be filled by individuals located in the Eastern Time Zone

Essential Functions & Responsibilities:

The essential functions and responsibilities for this position include, but are not limited to, the following. Other duties may be assigned as needed.

  • Framework Knowledge: Develop an understanding of North American utility benchmarking laws such as NYC LL84, BERDO, Los Angeles EBEWE, Ontario EWRB, and other local compliance requirements. Stay up-to-date on changes to reporting frameworks and utility processes.
  • Report Preparation: Lead the preparation and submission of benchmarking reports by extracting and organizing data from utilities and Measurabl’s products. Ensure reports are prepared and submitted correctly.
  • Timely Submittals: Ensure that all reports are submitted on time to the relevant authorities, meeting both regulatory and customer deadlines.

Compliance & Project Management

  • Ordinance Management: Oversee the preparation and submission of reports across a wide range of utility benchmarking programs.
  • Compliance Reporting: Project manages the preparation of various compliance reports, including those related to local ordinances and green loans. Ensure that relevant data such as building, utility, space, and certification information is accurately entered into the platform. Collaborate with the Data Advisory team for bulk data imports.
  • Discrepancy Investigation: Review and investigate any discrepancies and anomalies in data for compliance and sustainability reports, documenting and resolving issues prior to internal audits and submission to authorities.

Internal Resource Management & Advisory

  • Internal Updates: Continuously update internal resources and documentation as utility processes and internal processes evolve.
